protected_classifications_in_recorded_or.rationale: This guarded base equation defines trialChoice to return the carried result when the divisor scan has reached or passed N on its stated I >= 2 domain; it neither rewrites program execution nor asserts an independent mathematical fact.

This is the divisor branch of the guarded trialChoice recurrence, defining the next summary term after a zero remainder by carrying Y forward; it is an equation for the named summary rather than an operational or separately proved rule.

This is the non-divisor branch of the guarded trialChoice recurrence, defining the next summary term after a nonzero remainder by preserving R; it defines the summary and does not add a reusable domain fact.
This guarded equation defines the N < 2 case of the total xOrYSpec summary to select Y; it is one disjoint case of a named proof-term definition.

This guarded equation defines the N >= 2 case of xOrYSpec by delegating to trialChoice from candidate 2; it completes the named summary definition and is not established separately before being imported.

rules.text:
rule trialChoice(N, I, R, _Y) => R
    requires I >=Int N andBool I >=Int 2

rule trialChoice(N, I, _R, Y) => trialChoice(N, I +Int 1, Y, Y)
    requires I >=Int 2 andBool I <Int N
      andBool pyMod(N, I) ==Int 0

rule trialChoice(N, I, R, Y) => trialChoice(N, I +Int 1, R, Y)
    requires I >=Int 2 andBool I <Int N
      andBool pyMod(N, I) =/=Int 0

rule xOrYSpec(N, _X, Y) => Y
    requires N <Int 2

rule xOrYSpec(N, X, Y) => trialChoice(N, 2, X, Y)
    requires N >=Int 2
